color.summary: Almost no color in the interface: #222222 ink on white, #6c6c6c for secondary text, #dddddd borders, #f7f7f7 and #f2f2f2 fills. The brand's pink-to-magenta gradient (#e61e4d to #d70466) is kept for the main action and the search button; photos carry the rest.
missing: Light only: the public pages have no dark theme.

type.summary: One family, Airbnb Cereal, mostly at 14px (400 for text, 500 for emphasis) on an 18 to 20px line, 15 to 16px at 500 for listing titles and buttons, 12px for small print.

shape.summary: Soft and varied: 20px on listing photos, 12px on cards and chips, 8px on small buttons, 32px on dialogs. Search bars, chips and the wishlist heart are full pills.

spacing.summary: Steps of 4: 8, 12 and 24px are the most common, with 24px between cards and 16px inside them.

elevation.summary: Shadows mark what floats: a tight 2px 4px shadow on map pins and photo arrows, a soft 4px 10px to 8px 24px shadow on the search bar, menus and dialogs. Cards and listings stay flat.

button.summary: Airbnb names five button looks in the markup: brand (the pink gradient, one per view), primary (near-black fill), secondary (grey fill), tertiary (no frame, grey on hover) and secondaryOutline (white with a 1px border). Around them sit many single-purpose buttons: the wishlist heart, photo arrows, map price pins, row arrows.

https://www.airbnb.com/.title: Home
https://www.airbnb.com/.summary: The signed-out home page: the header with its category tabs, the floating search bar, full-width rows of small listing cards, and a tall grey footer.
layout: Some loads open on a 76px AI search banner; the 96px header follows.
The search bar is 850x66, centred under the header.
Rows run the full width with 48px side margins; cards are 180px, seven to a row.

https://www.airbnb.com/s/Paris/homes.title: Search results
https://www.airbnb.com/s/Paris/homes.summary: Results and a map side by side, under a compact header and a row of filter chips.
layout: Header 96px, the search collapsed to a 404x46 pill in its centre, then a 54px filter bar.
Results run from x48 to x710, two 307px cards to a row.
The map is 658px wide at x734 and fills the viewport's height under the bars (684px).
Pagination sits under the results; the footer is 625px.

https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/47803806.title: Listing
https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/47803806.summary: A listing: title and photos across the content width, then sections in a left column beside the booking card, then reviews, host and things to know across the width again.
layout: The photo grid is 1120x476 with 12px outer corners: one large photo and four small.
Below it the page splits: a 653px column and the 372px booking card at x899, which stays in view as the column scrolls.
Reviews, the host and things to know return to the full 1120px.

https://www.airbnb.com/host/homes.title: Become a host
https://www.airbnb.com/host/homes.summary: The hosting landing page: an earnings hero with a map, then stacked full-width sections: a banner, value props, co-hosts, AirCover and questions.
layout: Hero 800px: the headline and an earnings slider on the left, a 624x592 map on the right.
Narrow content centres at 848px (the banner, the questions), wide rows at 1216px (the co-hosts).
The footer is 625px, as on search and listings.

ai-search-banner.title: AI search banner
ai-search-banner.note: A 76px dark strip above the header that offers the new AI search, with an Off switch. It is an experiment: some loads leave it out.

site-header.title: Header
site-header.note: Logo, the Homes, Experiences and Services tabs, and Become a host with two round icon buttons. The tab icons are short videos, which the copy keeps as grey boxes.

search-bar.title: Search bar
search-bar.note: An 850x66 pill with a 1px #dddddd border and a soft 0 8px 24px shadow: Where, When and Who split by short rules, and the round gradient search button.

listing-row.title: Listing row
listing-row.note: A titled row of seven 180px cards, with small round arrows to page it.

listing-card.title: Listing card
listing-card.note: A photo with 20px corners, a Guest favorite pill in 80% white and a heart over it; title, price and rating under it, with no card surface.

profile-menu.title: Profile menu
profile-menu.note: A 265px menu with 12px corners and a 0 2px 16px shadow: groups of rows split by rules, one with a picture and a description. The first row shows a 2px focus ring because the capture opened the menu with the keyboard.

login-dialog.title: Log in dialog
login-dialog.note: A 480px dialog with 32px corners: a 60px field with a 1px inset ring and 12px corners, the full-width gradient Continue button (48px), and square Google and Apple buttons.

date-picker.title: Date picker
date-picker.note: Opens from When: a Dates and Flexible pill switch on #ebebeb, two months side by side, and pill chips for how flexible the dates are, the selected one outlined in #222222.

footer.title: Footer
footer.note: Three columns of links on #f7f7f7, then a bottom row with legal links, language and currency, and social icons. The copy leaves out the inspiration tabs above it.

search-header.title: Search header
search-header.note: On results the search bar collapses into a 404x46 pill inside the 96px header, with the same 1px #dddddd border and a lighter shadow.

filter-bar.title: Filter bar
filter-bar.note: A row of 34px chips: white, a 1px #dddddd border, 24px corners and 12px text; some carry a chevron for a menu.

result-card.title: Result card
result-card.note: The listing card at 307px with more lines: a 230px photo with 20px corners and dots, a Superhost pill, the title and rating, a description, beds, dates, and the old price struck through beside the new one.

featured-hotels.title: Featured hotels
featured-hotels.note: A 686px panel on warm #f7f6f2 with 20px corners and 24px padding: a header with a 1/5 counter and round arrows, a carousel of 270px hotel cards, and a white Search hotels button.

price-details.title: Price details
price-details.note: Opens from a card's price: a popover in 92.5% white with about 28px corners, a round close button, the price lines and a #f7f7f7 credit callout.

map.title: Map
map.note: Prices as white pills and neighborhood labels over the map, with round zoom and expand buttons. The tiles are drawn on a canvas, so the copy shows a grey base under them.

filters-dialog.title: Filters dialog
filters-dialog.note: A 568x820 dialog with 32px corners: a centred title and close button, sections split by rules (recommended tiles, a Type of place segmented control, price), and a footer bar with an upward shadow.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.note: Round 32px page buttons, the current one filled #222222 with white text, and an arrow at each end.

listing-title.title: Listing title
listing-title.note: The listing's name on the left; Share and Save as underlined text buttons with icons on the right.

photo-grid.title: Photo grid
photo-grid.note: One large photo and four small ones, with 12px corners on the grid's outside only, and a small Show all photos button over the last.

guest-favorite-strip.title: Guest favorite strip
guest-favorite-strip.note: A 653px box with a 1px #dddddd border and 12px corners: laurels, a one-line claim, the rating and the review count split by a rule.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.note: Three rows of an icon, a title and a muted line, with no surface.

booking-card.title: Booking card
booking-card.note: A 372px card with 12px corners, a 1px #dddddd border and a 0 6px 16px shadow: check-in, checkout and guests as one field group outlined in #8c8c8c, and the gradient Check availability button.

sleep-cards.title: Where you'll sleep
sleep-cards.note: Bedroom cards 207px wide with a 1px #dddddd border, 12px corners and 24px padding, bed icons above the name.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.note: Two columns of icon and label, and a #f2f2f2 Show all button, 48px with 12px corners.

inline-calendar.title: Calendar
inline-calendar.note: The date picker's two months, inline on the page: past and unavailable days struck through, and a Clear dates text button.

rating-summary.title: Rating summary
rating-summary.note: The guest favorite rating set large between laurels, with a short line under it. The copy stops above the category scores that follow on the page.

review.title: Review
review.note: Avatar, name and meta lines, a row of stars, and the review's text. Redacted, as it shows a guest.

host-profile.title: Host profile
host-profile.note: A 395px host card with 24px corners and the dialog's 0 8px 24px shadow (avatar, name, three stats), host details beside it, and a grey message button. Redacted, as it shows the host.

things-to-know.title: Things to know
things-to-know.note: Short sections in a three-column grid: an icon, a title, a muted line and an underlined Show more.

earnings-hero.title: Earnings hero
earnings-hero.note: A large centred headline with the estimate, a slider, a search pill, and a 624x592 map of nearby prices on the right.

hosting-banner.title: Hosting banner
hosting-banner.note: An 848px band on warm #f4f2ec with 24px corners: an illustration, a two-line pitch, and a #222222 pill button.

value-props.title: Value props
value-props.note: Three centred columns of an icon on a soft square, a title and a muted paragraph. The copy leaves out the section's title.

cohost-cards.title: Co-host cards
cohost-cards.note: Four 220x292 cards on #f7f7f7 with 30px corners and 30px padding: a 140px photo, a name, a short line and a strip of two stats. Redacted, as they show people.

aircover-list.title: AirCover list
aircover-list.note: Rows of what AirCover covers with green checks, split by 1px #dddddd rules, small print, and a 48px #222222 pill button. The copy leaves out the section's title and column headers.

faq.title: Questions
faq.note: Accordion rows 848px wide on #f7f7f7, split by 1px #dddddd rules, each with a chevron. The copy holds the rows only, not the section's title.

provenance.notes: Written section by section from the census (spec.json, census 7be1fff) and its page shots, public pages in light; pages and blocks from blocks.json's copies of 2026-10-25 and their computed styles. Names marked ai are ours; Airbnb publishes no component docs.
